thread:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT triggered: GPU capacity exhaustion in GCP us-south1. Severity: P1. Affected service: inference-runtime. Link: https://pagerduty.example.incident/INC-2143588800 :rotating_light:

emma: ack — oncall (emma) here. Starting triage. tagging @raj @maria.

raj: looking at autoscaler logs now. early read: controller failing to create node pool due to regional GPU quota. error: 'Google::Apis::ClientError (Quota exceeded - region us-south1 - GPU: NVIDIA_TESLA_A100)'.

dmitri: metrics snapshot from the cluster: queue_length went from ~200 -> 11.8k in ~7m, enqueue rate still high. Pod restart count increasing. p50 latency 1.2s -> p99 ~9.8s. Token backlog + throttles stacking.

maria: CS: we have ~14 paying customers reporting 5xx/502 on inference endpoints (API monitors confirm). I've created a support list and begun templated messaging.

emma: immediate goals: 1) stop queue growth, 2) restore core SLA traffic, 3) notify customers. Quick mitigations I'm starting: - flip routing to fallback model variants in other regions - throttle non-SLA tenants - evict low-priority batch jobs

raj: confirming autoscaler is in Pending state. controller logs:
```
E0412 21:46:15.123456       1 node_controller.go:324] Failed to create instance: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_A100' exceeded.
I0412 21:46:15.123789       1 scale_up.go:89] scale-up failed for nodegroup gpu-pool-us-south1: quotaExceeded
```

dmitri: I just opened a quota increase with GCP console (request id: 678901). TAM pinged. ETA from support voice: 2-3 hours best-case. We can't rely on that for immediate throughput.

maria: message to customers drafted: "We're experiencing degraded inference capacity in US South. We're rerouting traffic and throttling low-priority workloads. We'll update as we regain capacity." Want me to send now? :thinking_face:

emma: send it. Also set status page to 'degraded performance' for affected region.

raj: applying infra mitigations now: - block new batch/training job submissions in us-south1 - enable cross-region fallback routing to eu-west1/dedicated pools - evict low-priority pods (IDS=lp-*)
Command run:
```
# block new job submissions (control-plane flag)
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/ops/flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"block_new_jobs_us_south1","value":true}'

# evict low priority pods
kubectl get pods -n jobs -l priority=low -o name | xargs -r kubectl delete -n jobs
```

emma: also enabling model-fallback routing rule. This will route requests for large-llm models (a100-backed) to smaller quantized variants or to eu-west1 where capacity is available. This impacts latency/quality slightly but reduces 503s.

raj: applied routing change via control-plane. Rollout logs: 200 OK. Verified: ~40% of traffic for heavy models now diverted.

dmitri: I've enabled preemptible burst pools in us-central1 and aws-ca-central-1 and kicked off warmup. That may start accepting traffic in ~8-12m. Monitoring node provisioning.

maria: CS update sent to affected customers; responses being triaged. No legal escalation yet. One enterprise customer asked for ETA; told them "under investigation, mitigation in progress, ETA unknown".

emma: patch for autoscaler: adding temporary tolerance for quota-failures so the controller will prefer cross-region pools rather than keep retrying us-south1. Patching now and will roll to control-plane.

raj: autoscaler patch applied. controller log now shows: 
```
I0412 21:50:38.987654 scale_decision.go:45] choosing alternate pool: eu-west1-gpu-pool (capacity available)
I0412 21:50:39.001234 router.go:212] rerouting 38% of heavy-model requests to eu-west1
```

dmitri: quarantine note: cost impact will increase due to cross-region routing and preemptible use. Finance FYI.

emma: short term status: queue down from 11.8k -> 2.1k. Ingress throttled to ~60% to protect control-plane. 14 customers still seeing degraded service (timeouts or higher latency), 3 customers had retries succeed after fallback.

maria: updating customer list with who got fallback vs who still on us-south1. Also prepping follow-up message once we have stable drain.

oncall-bot: escalation: engineering manager dmitri notified and joined call. Paging next layer if more than 30m to resolution.

emma: timeline & handoff: I'm going to hand over to night oncall (@raj) at 21:30 UTC — current mitigations in place (routing + eviction + preemptible warmup). Please keep the ticket updated and watch queue.

raj: ack. I'll monitor and keep CS looped. If queue rises over 3k again I'll trigger further throttling and escalate to TAM for urgent quota bump.

dmitri: we should run a root-cause checklist postmortem: quota planning mismatch + autoscaler retry behavior + insufficient cross-region fallback policies. I'll own the postmortem doc.

emma: adding runbook items for immediate follow-ups: - update capacity planning thresholds for us-south1 - add automated reroute when region GPU quota errors exceed X/min - improve throttling controls per tenant

maria: will coordinate status post to customers in 30m with updated ETA if capacity improves.

oncall-bot: Incident P1 still active. Current state: partial mitigation, queue draining, reduced customer impact but degraded for some tenants. Handoff complete to @raj.

raj: signing off in channel for handoff. Monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd123/inference-us-south1 (watch panel: queue_length, pod_errors, region_quota_errors).

pagerduty-bot: Update added to PD incident INC-2143588800 — state: mitigation in progress.

emma: thanks team. I'll sync with dmitri for postmortem once fully stabilized.

maria: note: CS will follow up with customers with a detailed incident summary once root cause confirmed.

raj: (last) holding pattern: queue ~1.1k, no new quota creation attempts in progress in us-south1. If stable for 45m we can start gradual rollback of throttles.

oncall-bot: <auto> Channel archived to incident log after resolution.
